description: This Java source file defines a class `HonoSaslAuthenticator` which implements a SASL authentication mechanism supporting PLAIN and EXTERNAL methods for the Hono IoT service. It handles client certificate extraction, mechanism negotiation, and delegation of credential verification to an authentication service. The class manages the SASL process within a Vert.x Proton-based server environment, including processing responses, handling outcomes, and attaching authenticated users to connections.

classes.name: HonoSaslAuthenticator
classes.description: A SASL authenticator supporting PLAIN and EXTERNAL mechanisms, integrating with Vert.x Proton engine to authenticate clients for the Hono service.
